# Departure season and future drifter destinations

Training 2001–2019, validation on available 2020–2022 departures. A seasonal weight per horizon was chosen using two internal forward windows. Negative adjusted-minus-annual Brier favors the seasonal correction. The centered upper bound must be below zero to support a gain. Intervals condition on fitted forecasts and historical development data.
